targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::float AS "Keys" FROM "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" WHERE COALESCE(blocked, false) = false AND (expires IS NULL OR expires > NOW())
SELECT COUNT(*)::float AS "Teams" FROM "LiteLLM_TeamTable" WHERE blocked = false
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", '1h'), 'requests' AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", '1h'), 'errors' AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_ErrorLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(logs."startTime", '1h'), COALESCE(teams.team_alias, logs.team_id, 'unassigned') AS metric, SUM(logs.spend)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" logs LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_TeamTable" teams ON teams.team_id = logs.team_id WHERE $__timeFilter(logs."startTime") GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(users.user_alias, users.user_id, keys.user_id, 'unassigned') AS metric, SUM(logs.spend)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" logs LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" keys ON keys.token = logs.api_key LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_UserTable" users ON users.user_id = keys.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(logs."startTime") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT COALESCE(key_alias, key_name, 'unnamed') AS "Key", COALESCE(user_id, 'unassigned') AS "Owner", COALESCE(team_id, 'none') AS "Team", spend AS "Window spend", total_spend AS "Total spend", max_budget AS "Budget", expires AS "Expires", COALESCE(blocked, false) AS "Blocked" FROM "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" ORDER BY COALESCE(blocked, false) DESC, spend DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT "startTime" AS "Time", model_group AS "Model group", litellm_model_name AS "Provider model", exception_type AS "Type", status_code AS "Status" FROM "LiteLLM_ErrorLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") ORDER BY "startTime" DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT COALESCE(user_alias, user_id) AS "User", user_role AS "Role", COALESCE(team_id, 'none') AS "Default team", spend AS "Spend", max_budget AS "Budget", budget_reset_at AS "Budget reset", created_at AS "Created" FROM "LiteLLM_UserTable" ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT updated_at AS "Time", changed_by AS "Actor", action AS "Action", table_name AS "Object type", object_id AS "Object" FROM "LiteLLM_AuditLog" WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100
